description:
Depends on opi-gfy.3 (Interactive as GenServer) and opi-gfy.4 (UIContext refactor).

Once Interactive is a GenServer, define OctoPi.Coder.UIHost @behaviour in octo_pi_coder that captures the handle_call/handle_cast surface extensions need. Interactive implements it; Modes.Rpc can implement it over JSONL stdout (matching pi-mono's RpcExtensionUIContext vs InteractiveExtensionUIContext split).

Changes:
- Define @behaviour OctoPi.Coder.UIHost in octo_pi_coder with callbacks matching UIContext operations (select, confirm, input, notify, set_status, set_widget, etc.)
- Interactive implements UIHost via its handle_call/handle_cast clauses
- UIContext.bind closures call into UIHost instead of Interactive directly
- Rpc mode implements UIHost stubs (JSONL encoding path)

This makes the Coder→TUI dependency explicit and the headless path fillable.
title: UIHost behaviour: Coder-owned interface for extension UI calls
